notes.title: Quantum project v 1.11 update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40263069/1c2c9355c095ece6cbe53bbf2764c3f3a88e900a.png[/img]

[h1]Quantum project v 1.11 update[/h1]

- fixed a bug with the elevator
- redesigned the mechanics of using the elevator
- fixed a bug with the mine clearance menu hanging
- small edits in the weapon
- disabled somersault after landing, now the character just stays in place
- some minor fixes in the camera/view code
- fixes in the logic of some levels
- minor edits in robot AI
Have a nice game

notes.title: Quantum project hotfix v 1.1
notes.content:
Update Description
- at the crash level, saving didn't always work
- fixed a bug with getting stuck in textures when moving on the crossbar
- added cursor in tooltips
- added music to the "drone" and "Dogfight" levels
- fixed a bug with mines, now they cause damage
- fixed a bug with the mine clearing menu hanging
- reduced the speed of reading dialogs
- increased laser timings at the "Border" level
- the sound of opening the improvements menu now interacts with the overall volume level
- increased clearance radius
- in some levels, the positions of objects have been changed
- many other minor fixes
